news.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
news.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.
news.title_zh: 曼达尼称联邦政府在AI问题上失职，呼吁纽约人反击
news.summary_zh: 市长佐赫兰·曼达尼周一晚间表示，纽约人必须抵制“AI接管不可避免”的叙事，并要求制定保护公众、把权力交还民众的监管措施。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 地方官员公开呼吁对AI进行监管，可能推动城市层面的政策行动，并影响公众对AI治理的讨论。
news.title_en: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
news.summary_en: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.
news.why_it_matters_en: A local official publicly calling for AI regulation could spur city-level policy action and shape public debate on AI governance.

news.title: My obituary for programming
news.summary: My obituary for programming Jeremy Scheff poignantly captures the key loss caused by coding agents for career programmers who enjoyed the puzzle of developing code: Programming turned into one of the greatest jobs you could imagine. You got paid to work on tricky little logic puzzles. The trickier the puzzle, the more you got paid. But even pretty simple puz
news.summary_zh: 杰里米·谢夫在一篇评论中感伤地指出，编程智能体让热爱解谜式写代码的职业程序员失去了核心乐趣：编程曾是最理想的工作之一，靠解决棘手的逻辑谜题获得报酬。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这反映了AI编程工具对开发者职业认同和工作方式的冲击，是行业情绪的重要信号。

news.why_it_matters_en: It reflects how AI coding tools are reshaping developers' professional identity and work, a notable signal of industry sentiment.

news.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
news.summary: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.

news.summary_zh: 若交易达成，这将是Anthropic过去一年中达成的一系列巨额算力交易中的最新一笔。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 持续的巨额算力投入显示前沿AI公司对计算资源的激烈争夺，并可能影响算力供应格局。

news.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
news.summary: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.
news.title_zh: Hugging Face政策负责人称嵌入式AI评估员并非易事
news.summary_zh: 所谓“嵌入式评估员”，即把据称“中立”的第三方观察员安插进AI组织内部，这一想法近几个月流行起来，背景是AI实验室接连发生安全事件、引发对其技术潜在危害的担忧。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这提示AI安全治理的监督机制设计存在实际困难，影响监管与行业自律的可信度。
news.title_en: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
news.summary_en: The idea of embedded evaluators — supposedly "neutral" third-party observers placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months as AI labs grapple with safety incidents that have spurred concerns over potential harms.
news.why_it_matters_en: It highlights practical difficulties in designing AI safety oversight, affecting the credibility of regulation and industry self-governance.
news.image_license: Publisher/source image; reuse terms not independently verified
news.image_alt: Hugging Face 政策负责人：内置 AI 评估器并非易得的解决方案

news.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
news.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
news.title_zh: 微软称AI智能体如同内部威胁，因“前沿模型不可信”
news.summary_zh: 微软希望企业密切监控员工在不受OpenAI、Anthropic等AI实验室控制的系统中使用的智能体。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这反映出企业AI部署中的安全风险正被重新定位为内部威胁问题，可能推动企业加强智能体管控。
news.title_en: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
news.summary_en: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
news.why_it_matters_en: It shows enterprise AI security risks being reframed as insider-threat issues, potentially driving stricter agent controls.

news.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
news.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
news.title_zh: 亚马逊推出TorchNeuron开发工具，迄今对英伟达最大挑战
news.summary_zh: 亚马逊希望打破英伟达对PyTorch的掌控——这一免费工具包被用于构建大多数AI应用——从而让更多开发者在自家芯片等替代硬件上运行应用。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 若成功，这可能削弱英伟达在AI软件生态中的主导地位，改变AI芯片竞争格局。
news.title_en: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
news.summary_en: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.
news.why_it_matters_en: If successful, it could weaken Nvidia's dominance in the AI software ecosystem and reshape AI chip competition.

news.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
news.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
news.title_zh: 黑客攻击AI编程工具OpenCode，在用户AI账户上产生费用
news.summary_zh: OpenCode是开源AI编程智能体，已成为Claude Code和Cursor的热门替代品。黑客侵入其在线平台部分系统，窃取了一些用户的API密钥，而它求助的AI工具一再拒绝查看恶意代码。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这暴露了AI编程工具供应链与密钥管理的安全漏洞，也凸显AI辅助安全分析的局限。
news.title_en: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
news.summary_en: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
news.why_it_matters_en: It exposes security gaps in AI coding tool supply chains and key management, and highlights limits of AI-assisted security analysis.

news.image_alt: 黑客攻击 AI 编程工具 OpenCode，导致用户 AI 账户产生费用

news.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
news.summary: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

news.why_it_matters_zh: 这反映了消费者对智能设备体验的不满，以及AI被用于对抗厂商预装与追踪的逆向用途。

top5.title_zh: 黑客攻击AI编程工具OpenCode，盗用用户API密钥并产生费用
top5.title_en: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users' AI accounts
top5.what_zh: 开源AI编程代理OpenCode的在线平台部分被入侵，部分用户API密钥被盗，导致其AI账户产生费用；报道称其求助的AI工具拒绝查看恶意代码。
top5.what_en: Part of OpenCode's online platform was breached; some users' API keys were stolen, running up charges on their AI accounts. The AI tools it turned to for help reportedly refused to inspect the malicious code.
top5.why_zh: 直接暴露AI编程代理的密钥管理与供应链风险，对使用开源代理的开发者是现实警示。
top5.why_en: Directly exposes key-management and supply-chain risks in AI coding agents, a concrete warning for developers using open-source agents.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 安全事件证据明确，但细节有限，需以官方说明为准。
top5.editor_judgment_en: A clear security incident, but details are limited; rely on official statements.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 风险：API密钥泄露与意外计费；机会：推动密钥隔离与最小权限实践。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Risk: leaked API keys and unexpected billing; opportunity: push key isolation and least-privilege practices.
top5.action_zh: 若使用OpenCode，立即轮换API密钥并核查账单。
top5.action_en: If you use OpenCode, rotate API keys now and check billing.
top5.original_title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts

top5.image_alt: 黑客攻击 AI 编程工具 OpenCode，导致用户 AI 账户产生费用

top5.title_zh: 微软称AI代理如同内部威胁，前沿模型不可信任
top5.title_en: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as 'frontier models can't be trusted'
top5.what_zh: 微软建议企业密切监控员工使用的、接入非AI实验室控制系统的代理。
top5.what_en: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely monitor agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs.
top5.why_zh: 把代理治理类比内部威胁，为企业部署代理提供可操作的安全框架。
top5.why_en: Framing agent governance as insider-threat management gives enterprises an actionable security frame.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 方向明确，但缺少具体技术细节，属治理建议而非产品发布。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Clear direction but light on technical detail; governance advice rather than a product launch.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：代理权限审计需求上升；风险：过度限制拖慢落地。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: rising demand for agent permission audits; risk: over-restriction slows adoption.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文，梳理内部代理的权限与访问范围。
top5.action_en: Read the source and map internal agents' permissions and access scope.
top5.original_title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
top5.image_license: Publisher/source image; reuse terms not independently verified
top5.image_alt: 微软称 AI 智能体类似内部威胁，因为“前沿模型不可信”

top5.title_zh: 亚马逊推出TorchNeuron开发工具，加大挑战英伟达
top5.title_en: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
top5.what_zh: 亚马逊希望打破英伟达对PyTorch的掌控，让更多开发者在自家等替代芯片上运行AI应用。
top5.what_en: Amazon wants to break Nvidia's hold on PyTorch so more developers run AI apps on alternative chips like its own.
top5.why_zh: PyTorch是多数AI应用的构建工具，降低迁移门槛可能改变芯片生态。
top5.why_en: PyTorch underpins most AI apps; lowering migration friction could shift the chip ecosystem.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 战略意义大，但实际效果取决于工具成熟度，需验证。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Strategically significant, but real impact depends on tool maturity; needs verification.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：降低对单一芯片依赖；风险：迁移成本与兼容性问题。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: less dependence on one chip vendor; risk: migration cost and compatibility.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文了解工具范围，再评估是否试用。
top5.action_en: Read the source for scope, then assess whether to trial it.
top5.original_title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
top5.image_license: Publisher/source image; reuse terms not independently verified
top5.image_alt: 亚马逊推出 TorchNeuron 开发工具，迄今对英伟达最有力的挑战

top5.title_zh: 传Nscale与Anthropic洽谈又一笔450亿美元算力交易
top5.title_en: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
top5.what_zh: 报道称若交易达成，将是Anthropic过去一年一系列巨额算力交易中的最新一笔。
top5.what_en: If completed, it would be the latest in a string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.
top5.why_zh: 反映前沿模型公司对算力的持续巨额投入与集中化趋势。
top5.why_en: Reflects continued massive compute spending and concentration among frontier model firms.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 仅为传闻，金额巨大但未经证实，需谨慎对待。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Reported talks only; the figure is large but unconfirmed, treat cautiously.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：算力供应链相关方受益；风险：过度集中与资本压力。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: compute supply-chain players benefit; risk: concentration and capital strain.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并等待官方确认。
top5.action_en: Read the source and wait for official confirmation.

top5.title_en: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
top5.what_zh: 这家英伟达挑战者融资15亿美元以保持独立，此前曾引发收购兴趣。
top5.what_en: The Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent after drawing acquisition interest earlier this year.
top5.why_zh: 显示资本持续押注替代芯片与开放权重路线。
top5.why_en: Shows continued capital backing for alternative chips and open-weight approaches.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 融资与估值事实清晰，但产品竞争力仍需观察。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Funding and valuation facts are clear, but product competitiveness remains to be seen.

top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: alternative chip ecosystem expands; risk: fierce competition with Nvidia.

top5.action_en: Read the source for use of funds.

editorial.core_zh: 今日主线是AI代理的安全与治理：从OpenCode被黑到微软的内部威胁类比，代理落地正撞上信任与权限问题。
editorial.core_en: Today's throughline is agent security and governance: from the OpenCode breach to Microsoft's insider-threat framing, agent adoption is colliding with trust and permission issues.
editorial.trend_zh: 算力与芯片竞争持续升温，同时代理安全成为落地前提。
editorial.trend_en: Compute and chip competition keeps heating up while agent security becomes a prerequisite for deployment.
editorial.next_question_zh: 企业该如何为AI代理设定最小权限与可审计的访问边界？
editorial.next_question_en: How should enterprises set least-privilege, auditable access boundaries for AI agents?
